risks.risk: Headlamp projectors, bulbs or HID ballast may not work, or moisture inside the housing.
risks.proof: Clip of each headlamp connected to a battery or car with low beam, high beam and indicator lit.
risks.if_unproven: as not working, salvage housings only

risks.risk: Broken or glued mounting tabs and brackets on the headlamps, hidden underneath or behind.
risks.proof: Close photos of the back and underside of each headlamp showing every mounting tab.

risks.risk: Cracks in the lens or housing hidden by glare.
risks.proof: Close photo of each lens at an angle without flash glare.

risks.risk: Fitment year: parts may suit a different Prado generation than the buyer needs.
risks.proof: Photo of the part number label on the back of each headlamp and on the back of the grille.
risks.if_unproven: as generic Toyota Prado front parts of the generation the shape suggests

risks.risk: Grille clips broken or emblem loose on the back side.
risks.proof: Photo of the back of the grille showing all clips and the emblem mounting.

risks.risk: Taillights mentioned by the seller may not exist or may not be included.
risks.proof: Photo of the taillights if they are part of the sale.

proof_requests: Clip of each headlamp lit on a battery or car: low beam, high beam and indicator.
Photos of the back of each headlamp and grille showing part number labels and all mounting tabs and clips.
Confirm whether taillights are included and photograph them; otherwise the sale is grille and headlamps only.
Close angled photo of each headlamp lens without glare to check for cracks.
response.reason: Photos show a Toyota front grille and a pair of headlamps that fit the Prado shape, so it can be priced at worst case with lamps as not working and no taillights included. The seller's 'tailight' is contradicted by the photos, which show headlamps, and 'working' is unproven.
